sloka: हरयो दक्षिणम् पारम् गमिष्यन्ति समागताह् ।यद्यप्येष तु वृत्तान्तो वैदेह्या गदितो मम ॥६-१-१८॥।।
transliteration: harayo dakṣiṇam pāram gamiṣyanti samāgatāh ।yadyapyeṣa tu vṛttānto vaidehyā gadito mama ॥6-1-18॥।।

translations.english: "This has been told to me by Vaidehi. How will the monkeys cross the ocean(enquired Vaidehi)."
